about.text: Cow's milk cheese originally from the Chanco farm in Maule Region. Now it is produced all over south-central Chile, and represents almost 50% of Chilean cheese consumption.

sources.text: Chile's Gouda-like semi-hard cow cheese from the Maule region; Wikipedia gives no ripening time
